images.title: Type each purchase once. See what's left.
images.sub: A spend-first budget tracker: log it, and every total builds itself.

images.title: Every category against its budget.
images.sub: Example September: Eating out came to $214.00 against a $200.00 budget, so it shows Over budget and -$14.00 left. Groceries: $501.42 of $550.00.

images.title: One log. Type it once.
images.sub: Pick the category from a dropdown. Counts as fills in on its own and flags any row missing a date or category. Room for 1,000 rows.

images.title: Set a budget once.
images.sub: Example: $4,500.00 of income, $3,965.00 budgeted for bills, everyday spending and savings, $535.00 left to budget.

images.title: See where the money went.
images.sub: The five biggest everyday spends of the month, pulled from the log on their own.

images.title: Every category, month by month.
images.sub: Example, July to September: $13,485 in, $11,575 out, $1,910 left over.

images.title: Which months went over.
images.sub: Example: August went $13.78 over the budget; July and September came in under it.
